hook: One query() call. Layer by layer, it becomes a governed agent platform.
body:
This trailer tours the Claude Agent SDK: the loop query() runs for you, ClaudeAgentOptions where deny beats allow, tools and MCP servers, subagents, hooks, sessions, permission layers and structured outputs.

Each concept is a short animated flow that shows where the control actually sits.

Built for architects and engineers preparing for the Claude Certified Architect – Foundations (CCAR-F) exam.

🔊 Turn the sound on for the walkthrough.

The full CCAR-F prep course walks through this chapter by chapter, with a practice exam:
